bot.help:
WP Hunter bot

/time — show the check interval
/time 2h — change it (30m, 2h, 1h30m; a bare number means minutes)
/status — tracked plugins, interval, pages per run, next run
/run — check the configured pages and send the digest
/run 100 — check 100 pages (~10,000 plugins)
/run all — walk the whole WordPress.org directory
